prompts.name: start
prompts.description: Orient and start working in this project.
prompts.body:
You are working in **meta-research-toolkit** (`library`, `typescript`).

First call `meta_overview` — it is the canonical map of this server's tools, plugins and a `recommendedNextAction`. Follow the recommendation.

## Project shape

- Type: `library`
- Framework: _(none detected)_
- Monorepo tool: _(none)_
- Test runner: `bun`
- Package manager: `bun`

## Quality gates

- `lint` → `bunx tsc --noEmit`
- `test` → `bun test --coverage`
- `build` → `bun build src/typescript/index.ts --outdir dist`
- `dev` → `bun run src/typescript/index.ts`

## When you change the project

1. Re-run `meta_analyze_project` to refresh the analysis.
2. If the project grew (new scripts, new framework deps, new monorepo packages), call `meta_plan_mcp_project` to refresh the blueprint and `meta_create_project` to materialise the new tools.
3. Never invent tool names; only call what `overview` lists.

prompts.name: fix quality
prompts.description: Run the gates and fix what fails.
prompts.body:
Run the project quality gates in this order and fix what fails:
1. `lint` → `bunx tsc --noEmit`
1. `test` → `bun test --coverage`
1. `build` → `bun build src/typescript/index.ts --outdir dist`
1. `dev` → `bun run src/typescript/index.ts`

If a gate is broken because of an external dep (downstream service, network, missing env), record it as `external-gate-blocker` with the evidence and continue.
